description: Author a multi-step Rig as a graph the runtime executes for real. `nodes` are the steps, `edges` {from, to, guard?} wire them; `structure_type` linear | dag (default) | stateful_graph (loops with guarded edges; an unfired guard skips its target). A step with no binding is a model turn with NO tools. A step that must do something is bound: `endpoint` + `tool` + `params` (a real MCP tools/call — your own tools live at https://rokha.ai/mcp/jsonrpc, e.g. tool 'hunt_report', params {q: '{{input}}'}), `url` (HTTP fetch), `data_op` (memory), `signet_actor` (value under the runner's mandate), `questions` (a decision gate), `sub_rig` or `doc_input`. Template `{{input}}` and `{{upstream.<field>}}` inside values; keys ride `secret_refs`, never literals. Each distinct `key` is its own saved rig. Pass `name`, declare `input` and `outputs`. Then call rig_run (wait: true) in the same turn and lead with what it produced. Full field reference: tools_catalog {name: 'rig_author'}.

edges.description: Directed edges; add `guard` for a conditional route.

guard.description: {source: a `{{node.port}}` ref, op: eq | not_eq | contains | gt | gte | lt | lte | truthy | exists, value?}.

input.description: What the rig asks its runner for; fills `{{input}}`.

key.description: Storage key; each distinct kebab-case key is its own saved rig (default 'agent-rig').

name.description: The rig's name; gates Save and Run for a human.

nodes.description: The steps. Rarer fields (label, agent, model_policy, headers, data_type, doc_input, expects, produces, inputs, pos, state) are in the full reference.

data_op.description: A durable, owner-scoped memory step on data_key.

endpoint.description: MCP JSON-RPC URL for a real tools/call.

model.description: Pin a model id; non-Haiku needs the owner's key.

params.description: Call or fetch arguments; `{{input}}`, `{{upstream.<field>}}` and `{{secret:<alias>}}` template inside values.

questions.description: A DECISION step: {<id>: {type: 'noul' | 'choice' | 'score', instructions, criteria}} answered with probabilities; route on it with an edge guard such as {source: '{{decide.answers.enter.noul}}', op: 'gte', value: 0.7}.

secret_refs.description: The runner's saved keys this step may use: [{alias, as?}].

signet_action.description: Writes move value under the mandate; metrics, mandates, portfolio and price read; paper_* record a paper ledger. Default pay.

signet_actor.description: A Signet step under the RUNNER's mandate to this actor, e.g. 'rig:trader'; no credentials in the rig.

signet_target.description: Address, mint, wallet or paper ledger name; templates allowed.

signet_value.description: Amount in base units, never a decimal; `{{upstream.<field>}}` sizes it.

sub_rig.description: A saved rig id to run here as a sub-run.

url.description: HTTP fetch target; `{{input}}` may sit in the path or query.

outputs.description: What the rig declares it produces.

requirements.description: {model?: {exact | allowed[] | min_tier}, agent?: {kit, tools[]}} a runner must meet.

structure_type.description: linear = a chain; dag (default) = branches and fan-in; stateful_graph = loops with guards.

summary.description: One line on what the flow does.

name: rig_author
